Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was southbound in the left-turn lane at an intersection in Baytown, Texas, and stated that Driver 2, traveling
northbound, struck the side of the vehicle as Driver 1 turned left arcoss the opposing lane. Driver 2 confirmed this
account and said the impact occurred as Driver 1 began the turn. Two independent witnesses at the scene gave
statements consistent with both drivers, and photographs taken at the location show the collision in the position
described. The visible damage to both vehicles is largely consistent with a side impact of this type. Driver 1 is listed
as the named insured on the policy. A Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat and was identified by the
responding officer and the witnesses as present in the vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 1 reported pain in the right
shoulder at the scene. At this time it is not clear whether that injury resulted from this collision, and it will need to be
assessed further. No prior dmaage to the vehicle was known to the officer or reported by either driver.
